summary: National HealthCare Corp (NHC) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $525M Credit Agreement ($475M term loan + $50M revolving facility) with Bank of America as agent, dated May 26, 2026. The financing is conditioned on and intended to fund a portion of the purchase price for NHC's acquisition of certain assets and real property from National Health Investors (NHI) under a Purchase and Sale Agreement dated April 21, 2026. The facilities mature five years after the funding date. NHC anticipates drawing the full term loan and part of the revolver at closing. The transaction was previously disclosed and represents an asset purchase from a related party. Watch for regulatory and closing conditions; risk-arb centres on completion of the NHI acquisition.
